departures.implemented: the Writer has no count limit; the line limit (OQ2, 50 KiB) bounds a record
departures.why: before 0.8.0 the limit applied only to a run's completion event's data references (add_note had none), and that event holds one run reference now; restoring it as a refusal would add a refusal the design does not need

departures.design: 2.9 (OQ2): a text is kept whole up to its limits, never cut
departures.implemented: the texts the kit composes (an import's event, a run's completion, a project's creation) quote a field kept whole elsewhere (the import record's description, run.json's title, the marker's title) by at most 4,000 characters and `…` (writer.excerpt); a run's error summary is 300 characters for SystemExit as for an exception
departures.why: OQ2 is read as the rule of the text a caller records; with the whole text the kit's own records were refused after the data, run.json or the marker was written (review of PR 3), which 0.7.0 recorded cut at 4,000 characters

departures.design: 4.3: a refusal in a script is an exception
departures.implemented: a note the SDK makes in a run is judged when it is made, its line with the widest seq (writer.SEQ_BOUND, 12 digits): a line within 24 bytes of the limit is refused there that would fit outside a run
departures.why: the run writes the note when it finishes, with a seq not known before; judged then, a note over the line limit was lost after the script went on
